identityDecisions.rule: Same person; do not expose married name or marriage before story 1 paragraph 142. The name Irene Norton itself appears at paragraph 247.
Same person; preserve initial disguise. Do not reveal the royal identity before story 1 paragraph 55; full name is stated in paragraph 57.

One person; do not reveal alias linkage in initial card. Detection and reveal gates must be reviewed against the complete story; story 2 paragraph 195 names the captured intruder and paragraphs 206-209 explain the scheme.
Keep the apparent manager and later alias/companion revelations spoiler-gated. Do not globally equate the real author William Morris with this cover name.
Use book-local Watson identity consistently; never create a separate narrator entity for the pronoun I. Do not globally tag generic doctor.
Keep source Mrs. Turner in story 1. Do not silently substitute Mrs. Hudson from other Holmes works.
